title: CasPINS: An Integrated Platform for CRISPR/TALEN gRNA Design, Primer Generation, and Indel Analysis
description: CasPINS (Cas-Primer-Indel Suite) is a comprehensive, open-source platform for CRISPR/TALEN gRNA design, primer design, and indel analysis. Features both graphical and command-line interfaces for analyzing genome editing outcomes from Sanger sequencing data.

creators.name: Dasgupta, Rinki
creators.affiliation: Department of Psychiatry and Neuroscience, Dell Medical Center at University of Texas at Austin

creators.name: Das, Kaushik
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Applications, National Institute of Technology Jharkhand

notes: CasPINS was developed for comprehensive genome editing experiment design and analysis, supporting both CRISPR and TALEN systems.
references: Doench et al. (2016) Optimized sgRNA design to maximize activity and minimize off-target effects of CRISPR-Cas9. Nature Biotechnology
Moreno-Mateos et al. (2015) CRISPRscan: designing highly efficient sgRNAs for CRISPR-Cas9 targeting in vivo. Nature Methods
Brinkman et al. (2014) Easy quantitative assessment of genome editing by sequence trace decomposition. Nucleic Acids Research
